hook.name: EgyptHook
hook.description: Fairlaunch hook that atomically creates and funds an ETH/token pool in a single transaction, applying a block-decaying swap fee (from a configurable high rate down to a 5% floor) on ETH volume to deter launch sniping. Fees accrue as ERC-6909 claims inside the PoolManager and are paid out to a developer address on demand.
